editorial_findings: No factual or originality blocker identified in this bounded draft. The title and preview correctly frame a pilgrimage hill rather than a climatic hill station.

The attributed committee and dated reporting paragraphs distinguish tradition, institutional ideals and reporting. The short planning paragraph is adequate as an onward official link; do not pad it with unverified travel instructions.
The five compact notes support their associated passages; final native anchor targets and returns still require implementation review.

The photograph is a separate source family, not automatically derived from committee/reporting.
